prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1117; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the rear-end collision described in your file. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. Any statements, requests for information, or settlement discussions should come through counsel.

We ask that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to the at-fault driver, along with a certified declarations page for each policy that may apply to this loss, including any excess or umbrella coverage. Please also confirm whether a reservation of rights has been issued.

We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, telematics or vehicle data, repair estimates, adjuster notes, and any communications with the insured or third parties. Please suspend any routine deletion or destruction of these materials while the claim is pending.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
